translation.en: Know — may God the Exalted make you happy — that the morphologist, to know the measures, needs seven chapters: the sound, the doubled, the hamzated, the mithāl, the hollow, the defective and the lafīf.
translation.tr: Bil ki — Yüce Allah seni mesut etsin — sarfçı, vezinleri bilmek için yedi bâba muhtaçtır: sahîh, muzâaf, mehmûz, misâl, ecvef, nâkıs ve lefîf.

irab.ar: فِعْلُ أَمْرٍ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ، وَالْفَاعِلُ ضَمِيرٌ مُسْتَتِرٌ وُجُوبًا تَقْدِيرُهُ أَنْتَ.
irab.en: An imperative; its doer is «you».
irab.tr: Emir fiili; fâili «sen».

irab.ar: فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْفَتْحِ، وَالْكَافُ ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِلٌ مَبْنِيٌّ فِي مَحَلِّ نَصْبٍ مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ.
irab.en: A past verb; the pronoun suffix «your» is its object.
irab.tr: Mâzî fiil; bitişik zamir «senin» mef'ûlün bihtir.

irab.en: The doer (fa'il), in raf'; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: Fâil, merfû; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.ar: فِعْلٌ مَاضٍ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْفَتْحِ الْمُقَدَّرِ عَلَى الْأَلِفِ، وَالْفَاعِلُ ضَمِيرٌ مُسْتَتِرٌ تَقْدِيرُهُ هُوَ — جُمْلَةٌ مُعْتَرِضَةٌ لِلتَّعْظِيمِ.
irab.en: A past verb; its doer is a hidden pronoun «هُوَ» — a parenthetical clause of exaltation.
irab.tr: Mâzî fiil; fâili gizli zamirdir «هُوَ» — ta'zîm için mu'teriza cümlesi.

irab.ar: «أَنَّ» حَرْفُ تَوْكِيدٍ وَنَصْبٍ يَنْصِبُ الِاسْمَ وَيَرْفَعُ الْخَبَرَ.
irab.en: «that» — enne: it puts its noun in nasb and its predicate in raf'.
irab.tr: «-diği» — enne: ismini nasb, haberini ref eder.

irab.en: The noun of inna, in nasb; the sign is the fatha.
irab.tr: İnne'nin ismi, mansûb; alâmeti fetha ile.

irab.ar: فِعْلٌ مُضَارِعٌ مَرْفُوعٌ، وَعَلَامَةُ رَفْعِهِ الضَّمَّةُ الظَّاهِرَةُ، وَالْفَاعِلُ ضَمِيرٌ مُسْتَتِرٌ تَقْدِيرُهُ هُوَ.
irab.en: A present verb, in raf'; its doer is a hidden pronoun «هُوَ».
irab.tr: Muzâri fiil, merfû; fâili gizli zamir «هُوَ».

irab.en: «in» — a preposition.
irab.tr: «-de, içinde» — harf-i cer.

irab.en: In jarr after the preposition; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: Mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: «to» — a preposition.
irab.tr: «-e, -e doğru» — harf-i cer.

irab.en: In jarr after the preposition; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: Mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: A substitute (badal); the same case as its head; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Bedel; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

translation.en: And he needs the derivation of nine things from every maṣdar: the past, the present, the imperative, the prohibition, the two nouns of the doer and of the object, and the nouns of place, of time and of the instrument.
translation.tr: Bir de her masdardan dokuz şeyin türetilmesine muhtaçtır; bunlar: mâzî, muzâri, emir, nehiy, ism-i fâil ile ism-i mef'ûl, ism-i mekân, ism-i zaman ve ism-i âlettir.

irab.ar: الْوَاوُ عَاطِفَةٌ، وَمَعْطُوفٌ مَجْرُورٌ بِالْكَسْرَةِ، مُضَافٌ.
irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.ar: مُضَافٌ إِلَيْهِ مَجْرُورٌ بِالْفَتْحَةِ نِيَابَةً عَنِ الْكَسْرَةِ لِأَنَّهُ مَمْنُوعٌ مِنَ الصَّرْفِ.
irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the fatha in place of the kasra — a diptote.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre yerine fetha ile — gayr-i munsarif.

irab.en: «from, of» — a preposition.
irab.tr: «-den» — harf-i cer.

irab.en: In jarr after the preposition; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: Mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.ar: الْوَاوُ عَاطِفَةٌ، وَضَمِيرٌ مُنْفَصِلٌ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى الْفَتْحِ فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ.
irab.en: The waw conjoins; «she / it» — a detached pronoun; in the place of raf'.
irab.tr: «ve» + «o (dişil)» — munfasıl zamir, mahallen merfû.

irab.ar: خَبَرٌ مَرْفُوعٌ بِضَمَّةٍ مُقَدَّرَةٍ عَلَى الْيَاءِ لِلثِّقَلِ.
irab.en: The khabar (predicate), in raf'; the sign is an implied damma on the ya.
irab.tr: Haber, merfû; alâmeti yâ üzerinde takdîrî damme ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.ar: الْوَاوُ عَاطِفَةٌ، وَمَعْطُوفٌ مَرْفُوعٌ بِالْأَلِفِ لِأَنَّهُ مُثَنًّى، وَحُذِفَتِ النُّونُ لِلْإِضَافَةِ.
irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined to the word before it, in raf'; the sign is the alif — a dual whose nun is dropped for annexation.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf, merfû; alâmeti elif ile — tesniye, izâfet sebebiyle nûnu düşmüştür.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti kesre ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

irab.en: The waw conjoins; joined by the conjunction to the word before it; the same case; the sign is the damma.
irab.tr: «ve» + ma'tûf; aynı i'râb; alâmeti damme ile.

translation.en: So I divided it into seven chapters.
translation.tr: Bu yüzden onu yedi bâba ayırdım.

irab.ar: الْفَاءُ عَاطِفَةٌ، وَفِعْلٌ مَاضٍ مَبْنِيٌّ عَلَى السُّكُونِ لِاتِّصَالِهِ بِضَمِيرِ رَفْعٍ مُتَحَرِّكٍ، وَالضَّمِيرُ فِي مَحَلِّ رَفْعٍ فَاعِلٌ، وَالْهَاءُ ضَمِيرٌ مُتَّصِلٌ مَبْنِيٌّ فِي مَحَلِّ نَصْبٍ مَفْعُولٌ بِهِ.
irab.en: The fa conjoins; a past verb with its subject pronoun suffix as doer; the pronoun suffix «his/its» is its object.
irab.tr: «bunun üzerine» + mâzî fiil; bitişik ref zamiri fâildir; bitişik zamir «onun» mef'ûlün bihtir.

irab.en: «on, upon» — a preposition.
irab.tr: «üzerine» — harf-i cer.

irab.en: In jarr after the preposition; the sign is the kasra; annexed (mudaf).
irab.tr: Mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile; muzâf.

irab.en: The annexed noun (mudaf ilayh), in jarr; the sign is the kasra.
irab.tr: Muzâfun ileyh, mecrûr; alâmeti kesre ile.
